about: Answers aimed at the schools' marking habits (docs/english-marking-conventions.md, 14 Oct 2026) — a quote with no explanation, the device named alone, a right idea joined to a contradicting one, a feeling far too strong, the same idea twice, a restatement where an inference is asked, a quote that drops the word carrying the idea — plus right answers the new rules must NOT mark down (lifting on an evidence question, a clumsy full answer). Each at a mark the writer is sure of. Read with: run.ts --hard --answers conventions-answers.json --plan-only, then plan.ts export / import, then run.ts --hard --answers conventions-answers.json --report-only.
